{{Quote|Sir, I hardly think that recruiting mercenaries is a good idea.|Felben Cuplatt to his boss, Crizby Rumbo|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''Felben Cuplatt''' was an employee of [[Cosmohaul Shipping]] and worked for [[Crizby Rumbo]] at the company. He was a nervous man and his nerves showed when he had to report to Rumbo that one of their cargo ships carrying [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] flame silks had been captured by [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] that claimed to be employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had resisted and was shot so the [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] had to pilot the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] back to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. He commented that the previous shipments were left alone due to the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] escort provided by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] however the New Republic was withdrawing its escorts due to cost and need. When Rumbo suggested they hire cheap guards to catch the privateers in the act he protested however Rumbo ignored his objections and in the end Cuplatt or another Cosmohaul employee engaged [[Paxtrell Snoygal]] to hire the mercenaries which Rumbo had dubbed 'freelance marines'.<ref name="AJ9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Felben Cuplatt was created by [[Thomas Bowling]] for the article ''[[Droids Defiant]]'' that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 9]] in February [[1996]]. It was published as a supplement to [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] created by [[West End Games]].<ref name="AJ9" />
